dialogues.jp: だらだら。
dialogues.en: Doodle.
dialogues.text: Doodle.

dialogues.jp: だらだら。
dialogues.en: Doodle.
dialogues.text: Doodle.

dialogues.en: Doodle.
dialogues.text: Doodle.

dialogues.jp: 「うららかな日曜の午後だ」
dialogues.en: "It's a glorious Sunday afternoon."
dialogues.text: "It's a glorious Sunday afternoon."

dialogues.jp:
窓からの柔らかい光を腕でふせぎつつ、うつら
うつらとベッドで船をこぐ。
dialogues.en:
I doze off on the bed, my arms over my face to keep off the
soft sunlight filtering through the window.
dialogues.text:
I doze off on the bed, my arms over my face to keep off the
soft sunlight filtering through the window.

dialogues.jp:
テスト勉強の疲れも残っているのか、もぅ、今
日はこのまま何事もなく寝ていたい……。
dialogues.en:
I feel like sleeping all day long, without doing anything to
recover my energy after the exams.
dialogues.text:
I feel like sleeping all day long, without doing anything to
recover my energy after the exams.

dialogues.jp: 上半身を起こして窓を見つめる。
dialogues.en: I sit up and look at the window.
dialogues.text: I sit up and look at the window.

dialogues.jp:
どうにも、こういう時のパターンとしては、窓
からさくら辺りが飛び込んでくる気がひしひし
と。
dialogues.en:
I can't stop feeling that Sakura might come in from the
window as usual when I'm in this situation.
dialogues.text:
I can't stop feeling that Sakura might come in from the
window as usual when I'm in this situation.

dialogues.jp: 「よし」
dialogues.en: "All right, then."
dialogues.text: "All right, then."

dialogues.jp:
うららかな春の日を守るために、俺は立ち上がっ
た。
dialogues.en: I stand up to protect this glorious day in spring.
dialogues.text: I stand up to protect this glorious day in spring.

dialogues.jp: 「えーと、瞬間接着剤と、ものさしでいいかな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I need instant glue and a ruler."
dialogues.text: "Well, I need instant glue and a ruler."

dialogues.jp:
プラスチックの１５センチ。ちょっと強度にか
けるかも知れないが、まぁ、大丈夫だろう。
dialogues.en:
Plastic, fifteen centimeters long. It may not be that
strong, but it'll do.
dialogues.text:
Plastic, fifteen centimeters long. It may not be that
strong, but it'll do.

dialogues.jp:
鍵の壊れている窓によって、窓を少し開け閉め
してみる。
dialogues.en:
I approach the broken-locked window, and open and shut it a
few times.
dialogues.text:
I approach the broken-locked window, and open and shut it a
few times.

dialogues.jp: 「さって」
dialogues.en: "Here."
dialogues.text: "Here."

dialogues.jp:
びーっ、と接着剤をものさしの片端に塗って、
窓の合わせ目に差し込む。
dialogues.en:
I put the glue on the edge of the ruler, then insert it
between the joints of the window.
dialogues.text:
I put the glue on the edge of the ruler, then insert it
between the joints of the window.

dialogues.jp: 「……いけるかな」
dialogues.en: "I hope it works."
dialogues.text: "I hope it works."

dialogues.jp: そこそこ力をいれても――よし、大丈夫。
dialogues.en:
It's got to be strong enough for decent force...... Okay,
good.
dialogues.text:
It's got to be strong enough for decent force...... Okay,
good.

dialogues.jp:
内側からだと、ものさしを引っこ抜くだけで大
丈夫だが外側からはどうだろう。
dialogues.en:
It works just pulling the ruler from the inside, but I
wonder how well it'll work from the outside.
dialogues.text:
It works just pulling the ruler from the inside, but I
wonder how well it'll work from the outside.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いっか……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I hope it's okay."
dialogues.text: "Well, I hope it's okay."

dialogues.jp:
面倒になってきたし、これ以上やってると、こ
の作業が面白くて寝れそうにないので終了。
dialogues.en:
I'm getting a bit tired, and if I keep doing this, I'd get
too enthusiastic about this project to go back to sleep.
dialogues.text:
I'm getting a bit tired, and if I keep doing this, I'd get
too enthusiastic about this project to go back to sleep.

dialogues.jp:
｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺しながら、かけ布団だけひきずっ
て窓から死角の場所で丸くなる。
dialogues.en:
Suppressing a yawn, pulling up the blanket, I curl myself up
in the blind spot you can't seen from outside.
dialogues.text:
Suppressing a yawn, pulling up the blanket, I curl myself up
in the blind spot you can't seen from outside.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やほーい♪」
dialogues.en: "Yoo-hoo!"
dialogues.text: "Yoo-hoo!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「…………うわ、危なっ」
dialogues.en: "Oh my God!"
dialogues.text: "Oh my God!"

dialogues.jp: 今日の俺は冴えてて眠い。
dialogues.en: Today I'm both psychic and sleepy.
dialogues.text: Today I'm both psychic and sleepy.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　いないのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Isn't he here?"
dialogues.text: "Oh? Isn't he here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと下も見てこようか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go see down there, too."
dialogues.text: "Let's go see down there, too."

dialogues.jp: ――がたがた。
dialogues.en: Rattle.
dialogues.text: Rattle.

dialogues.jp:
どうしてそこで、玄関に回ろうとしないのだろ
うかこいつは……。
dialogues.en: Why doesn't she try to go around to the front door?
dialogues.text: Why doesn't she try to go around to the front door?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ、開かない？」
dialogues.en: "Oops, it doesn't open."
dialogues.text: "Oops, it doesn't open."

dialogues.jp: その前に不法侵入だ。
dialogues.en: I'd call this 'breaking in'.
dialogues.text: I'd call this 'breaking in'.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ない。うたまる、お兄ちゃんが帰ってく
　るか見ててね」
dialogues.en: "Oh well. Utamaru, stay here until oniichan comes back."
dialogues.text: "Oh well. Utamaru, stay here until oniichan comes back."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow!"
dialogues.text: "Meow!"

dialogues.jp: え？
dialogues.en: What?
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「え、置いていかないで……う〜ん、後で猫缶
　あげるからちょっとだけ」
dialogues.en:
"You don't want me to leave you here, huh? I'll give you
canned food later, so please!!"
dialogues.text:
"You don't want me to leave you here, huh? I'll give you
canned food later, so please!!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ん、それじゃ。ボクは近所をちょっと見てく
　るね」
dialogues.en: "Okay, then. I'll go look around the neighborhood."
dialogues.text: "Okay, then. I'll go look around the neighborhood."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow, meow~."
dialogues.text: "Meow, meow~."

dialogues.jp:
がさがさ、と桜の枝を揺らす音がして、辺りが
静まる。
dialogues.en:
I hear the rustling sound of the cherry branches, and then
it goes quiet again.
dialogues.text:
I hear the rustling sound of the cherry branches, and then
it goes quiet again.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Meow~."
dialogues.text: "Meow~."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Meow~."
dialogues.text: "Meow~."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Hmmm..."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm..."

dialogues.jp: つぶらな瞳に見つめられている気配が……。
dialogues.en: I feel lovely round eyes staring at me.
dialogues.text: I feel lovely round eyes staring at me.

dialogues.jp: すっく、と立ち上がり窓を開ける。
dialogues.en: I get off my knees and open the window.
dialogues.text: I get off my knees and open the window.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「……お前も苦労してるな」
dialogues.en: "It must be hard for you."
dialogues.text: "It must be hard for you."

dialogues.jp:
窓辺によりかかって天気のいい外を眺めながら
大きくため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
I take a big sigh, leaning on the windowsill, looking at the
beautiful weather outside.
dialogues.text:
I take a big sigh, leaning on the windowsill, looking at the
beautiful weather outside.

dialogues.jp:
そのうち、さくらが一周して戻ってくるから、
そうしたら遊んでやろう。
dialogues.en:
Before long, Sakura will come back, and then I'll be forced
to play with her.
dialogues.text:
Before long, Sakura will come back, and then I'll be forced
to play with her.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを考えつつ、後数分のはずの穏やか
な日曜の午後をかみしめることにした。
dialogues.en:
With those thoughts in my head, I try to enjoy a few minutes
of peace left over on Sunday afternoon.
dialogues.text:
With those thoughts in my head, I try to enjoy a few minutes
of peace left over on Sunday afternoon.

dialogues.jp: ◆平和な日曜の午後◆
dialogues.en: ◆Peaceful Sunday afternoon◆
dialogues.text: ◆Peaceful Sunday afternoon◆

dialogues.jp:
昼寝の邪魔がはいるような気がして、さくら対
策に窓を開かないようにして床で寝ることにし
た。
dialogues.en:
I decided to sleep on the floor after locking the window
completely to keep Sakura away, so I can have a nice
afternoon nap.
dialogues.text:
I decided to sleep on the floor after locking the window
completely to keep Sakura away, so I can have a nice
afternoon nap.

dialogues.jp:
案の定、さくらが来るが、窓が開かないという
ことで白猫をおいて立ち去ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
As anticipated, Sakura came by, but she went away because
she couldn't open the window. But she left her white cat
there.
dialogues.text:
As anticipated, Sakura came by, but she went away because
she couldn't open the window. But she left her white cat
there.

dialogues.jp:
そのつぶらな瞳と泣き声に負けた俺は、苦笑い
を浮かべながら、さくらと遊んでやることにし
た。
dialogues.en:
After I gave in to the cat's lovely round eyes and cry, I
smiled bitterly and was forced to play with Sakura.
dialogues.text:
After I gave in to the cat's lovely round eyes and cry, I
smiled bitterly and was forced to play with Sakura.
